description: File a report when workspaceAlberta blocked the task: a bug, a missing capability, a confusing tool description, or a wrong result. Say what you were trying to do, which tool you used, what went wrong, and a proposed fix. A person reviews the report. This tool does not open a pull request, change the server, submit a bid, or contact a buyer. Do not use it for procurement search, tender questions, bid advice, or to send secrets, tokens, API keys, or customer documents. Do not call it again for the same problem after it returns a feedback id.

category.description: What kind of gap this is.

client_name.description: Optional name of the agent or client, such as cursor.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

proposed_fix.description: What should change in the tool, the description, or the server. A person decides whether to do it.

severity.description: How blocked the task is. Defaults to medium.

summary.description: One sentence a person can scan. No secrets.

tool_name.description: The workspaceAlberta tool you called. Empty if none fit.

what_i_was_trying_to_do.description: The task you were trying to finish for the user.

what_went_wrong.description: What the tool returned or refused, and how that blocked the task. No secrets or tokens.

name: submit_feedback
title: Report a gap or bug
